instruction: Candid medium shot photograph. On an indoor squash court, the woman in the white athletic dress (R2) stands on the left, facing right, and high-fives the man in the blue t-shirt and black shorts (R1) standing on the right. Both smile warmly as their raised right hands meet. The woman holds her racket in her left hand, and the man holds his racket in his left hand. Bright, even indoor lighting fills the court.
